$comment: Presentation-only overrides for city markers. A city is created automatically for every distinct `city` in universities.json; its position defaults to the mean of its universities' coordinates. Entries here override that. `label` is the side the name sits on (n/ne/e/se/s/sw/w/nw) - tuned so no label covers a coastline detail, a pin, or another label. `leader` draws a thin line from dot to label when the label has to sit further out.
